market_outlook.short_term: ASX200 likely range-bound to modestly lower over 1–3 months. Iron ore crash and Fed hawkishness cap upside; oil spike and gold/critical-minerals provide partial support. ANZ.AX cost-cutting and housing weakness weigh on financials. Expect volatility around Fed meeting.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if iron ore stabilises and Australia's energy transition delivers. Immigration policy overhaul may support near-term GDP but structural productivity gap remains. Housing correction could extend 6–9 months. Critical minerals and gold offer structural tailwinds.
